_about: Round 6's karma gate spec for qa/gate.py (film-qa gate --spec). Built on r5/gate_spec.json. complaints: no waiver on these areas. Round 6 adds garment.open_edge_shrunk (the operator, 07 Nov: 'his neck looks very weird, also it looks like it has a cut') and lips.eye_onsets (the orchestrator's signed per-line strip check); lips.render_lag_frames becomes INFO by the orchestrator's ruling (an invalid measure, a scope change, not a waiver). Numbers: r6/numbers/*.json in the gate contract, merged by r6/merge_numbers.py.

shot.start_motion_ratio.what: head-box motion in a presenter shot's first 4 frame pairs over the median of the next 12 (r5/gate_numbers.py settle on the rendered frames): a head snapping into its pose or a hair sim settling at the cut
shot.start_motion_ratio.where: S15 f1080-1084 (her head tilts in ~10 deg)
r4: round 4's S15 final_d, the same shape as round 5 (12.33): her head tilt-in is pre-existing
shot.start_motion_ratio.why: orchestrator, 06 Nov round 5b: her S15 start tilt is pre-existing (round 4 the same), NOT a blocker tonight, but REPORTED in the gate, not hidden; INFO until calibrated (shot starts move by design: S16 reads 2.8)

garment.open_edge_shrunk.what: face-mesh vertices on its OPEN lower edge (the stitch to the body at the neck base) that the neck backstop shrinks: a shrunk open edge pulls the face off the body and reads as a torn lip / dark crevice above the collar
garment.open_edge_shrunk.where: his face mesh as built for the finals (S13, S15 sharp frames show it)
garment.open_edge_shrunk.how: r5/neck_backstop.py mask report shrunk_on_open_edge (agent-02 b07e8fd1) on the mask the finals' build used; 0 by construction when no backstop shrink is applied (say so in the number's where)
must_fail: round 5b loop 2 (the delivered candidate): 92/92 open-edge verts shrunk; the orchestrator saw a ragged lip + crevice at f1085/1100/1128 and the operator 'a cut'
garment.open_edge_shrunk.why: neck_px cannot see a torn skin edge ABOVE the collar (gate v2, round 5b); this is the geometric cause, measured

r4: INFO in round 6 by the orchestrator's ruling (cc-64d05f6e, 07 Nov): an invalid measure. Round 5b evidence: the round-4 control fails too (L1 +6.64, L2 +16.95, L4a +12.38), the sign is random, it is not repeatable (round 4 L1 -1.36 -> +6.64 on new boxes). A scope change, not a waiver; the curve items stay hard. agent-01's landmark measure replaces it as a hard line once validated (null control, round 4 L1, a +6 f shifted mux)

lips.eye_onsets.what: the orchestrator's by-eye check of mouth onset vs audio onset on EVERY line of the rendered cut: 1 only if every line reads a 0-2 frame lead (mouth opens 0-2 f before the sound) or is occluded with the occlusion named
lips.eye_onsets.where: every VO line of the 65 s cut (L1, L2, L3a, L3b, L4a, L4b)
lips.eye_onsets.how: strip file signed by cc-64d05f6e: r6/numbers/eye_onsets.json {"lines": {line: {"lead_f": n | null, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"|"occluded", "note"}}, "by": "cc-64d05f6e"} -> r6/merge_numbers.py
r4: round 4: lips moved before the audio on L1 (the operator)
lips.eye_onsets.why: the render measure is invalid; the eye is the judge the operator is, line by line, written down

r4: round 5b read 8.93 at S15 f1082 (her pre-existing start tilt-in, place() cross-fade on screen): round 6 renders S15 WITH agent-04's place fix (b475dfe5, b22f3372); no exclusion window

shot.settle_step_deg.what: worst frame-to-frame head turn beyond perfkit's plan at a section's start or the film's end (perf.py settle, AFTER samples)
shot.settle_step_deg.where: each presenter section start and the film's last frame f1559
r4: round 5b read 13.65 on the rendered S15 start (start_motion_ratio); before e4c9c01f f1559 read him 1.999 / her 4.201
shot.settle_step_deg.why: agent-04 K2: INFO until calibrated; shot.start_motion_ratio stays the render-side diagnostic

garment.leaders_ok.what: every garment of each presenter (his Tee/Trousers/shoes, her Top/Overshirt/Trousers/shoes) follows Body (leader pose == Body) AND his body-hide mask is on, read right before EVERY final job
garment.leaders_ok.where: the level, before each final render job (the worst job counts)
garment.leaders_ok.how: agent-06's pre-render check (dress_him/dress_her + seq_dress, then the leaders read-back) -> r6/numbers/box.json
must_fail: round 6 r6n0 baseline (07 Nov): the tee stopped following his body, a dark band of body through the whole upper chest (orchestrator)
garment.leaders_ok.why: the orchestrator, 07 Nov: a hard pre-render check, every garment's leader == Body

shot.face_luma_ratio.what: each presenter's face-box mean luma on a still of the shot over round 4's same frame (same camera), worst presenter shot, read before the finals
shot.face_luma_ratio.where: S13 f1040, S15 f1128 (and each presenter shot's first frame)
shot.face_luma_ratio.how: films/host-studio/reel/r6/face_luma.py (agent-06, fleet/agent-06/r6-boxa 8b80bacc) on a still vs round 4's final_d frame, on the box -> r6/numbers/box.json. The face box must come from EACH image's own face (a pose that moved since round 4 reads as light otherwise: her S15 f1128 read 1.142 from position alone)
must_fail: round 6 r6n0 broken baseline (agent-06, final-spec still): his face S13 f1040 0.119, S15 f1128 0.236 of round 4 (0.131 / 0.266 of round 5b's final): the 'very dark face' the orchestrator saw
shot.face_luma_ratio.why: the orchestrator, 07 Nov: a still's face luma within +-10% of round 4's before any render

garment.cull_kept_moved_cm.what: largest displacement of any KEPT face vertex after the chest-flange cull (cull_live): the cull removes, it never moves what stays
garment.cull_kept_moved_cm.where: his face mesh as built for the finals
must_fail: round 5b loop 2's shrink moved kept verts up to 2.99 cm and tore the open edge
garment.cull_kept_moved_cm.why: the orchestrator, 07 Nov (r6n1): apply the cull only; nothing near the visible neck may move

garment.cull_min_below_collar_cm.what: smallest distance below the tee's collar edge of any CULLED face vertex (every culled vertex is under the tee and at least 3 cm below the collar)
garment.cull_min_below_collar_cm.where: his face mesh as built for the finals
must_fail: a cull reaching the collar line would open a hole at the visible neck
garment.cull_min_below_collar_cm.why: the orchestrator, 07 Nov: cull only, under the tee; the accepted state is r6n2 = 'Epic's tee untouched + the 1.5 cm cull' (the orchestrator's GO for the finals), so the line is that cull's depth; neck_visible (0 on the finals) is the independent check that no hole shows

garment.neck_px.what: VISIBLE neck poke-through, worst frame (qa.clip neck_visible, agent-02 e71f06fa/a670ea02): Face skin the render shows through his tee, as ISLANDS (skin enclosed by cloth, any size) plus TONGUES (skin joined to the collar opening that runs more than tongue_cm down into the cloth, walked in cm at its depth). Known blind spot: a poke joined to the rim cluster and shallower than tongue_cm passes; the orchestrator's crops judge that case
garment.neck_px.where: S13, S15, S17, S18 (6 frames each, the finals' state)
garment.neck_px.how: film-ue op qa.clip ... neck_rule=visible tongue_cm=3.0 (agent-02 a7511df9: 2x r6n2's max tongue 1.49 cm) -> metrics.worst.neck_visible.px; or python -m filmtools.unreal.neckscan <out_dir> on its depth files
r4: round 4 S15 1-3 px on the OLD rim measure, waived then; not re-read on the visible measure
must_fail: round 6 r6n1 (box A clipr6c1, agent-06's neckscan): a 39 px skin island under the collar at S15 f1128, islands in all 4 shots: the blob the orchestrator saw. r6n2 (clipr6c3, passed by eye) reads 0, max tongue 1.49 cm
garment.neck_px.why: the orchestrator, 07 Nov: re-scope neck_px to VISIBLE poke-through, honestly and calibrated; a measure fix with must_fail, not a waiver (the rim measure read 262 on a hug the eye passed)

garment.neck_rim_px.what: the OLD neck_px (Face>tee px more than neck_margin_cm under the collar rim), kept beside the visible measure so the change shows in the gate log
garment.neck_rim_px.how: qa.clip metrics.worst.neck_px (reported by neck_rule=visible as info)
r4: r6n2 read 262 at the rim on a collar the orchestrator passed by eye: the measure's blind spot (r5b)
garment.neck_rim_px.why: transparency: the re-scope must be visible, not silent

r4: INFO with lips.render_lag_frames (the orchestrator's ruling, 07 Nov): it is a property of that render measure (its own r4 note), which round 5b showed invalid; it returns as a hard line with agent-01's landmark measure
